title: Add POST /api/ai — generic Workers AI endpoint conforming to OpenAI Responses API schema
body:
Adds a new `POST /api/ai` endpoint backed by the existing `AIWORKER` Workers AI binding. Accepts requests matching the OpenAI Responses API request schema and returns responses in the corresponding response schema format.

### Request → Workers AI mapping
- `input` (string or message-object array) + `instructions` → `messages[]` with optional `system` role prepend
- `temperature`, `top_p`, `max_output_tokens` forwarded directly
- `reasoning.effort` (`none`/`low`/`medium`/`high`) scales `max_tokens` by 0.25×/0.5×/1×/2×; invalid values return 400

### Response shape
```json
{
  "id": "resp_<uuid>",
  "object": "response",
  "created_at": 1746014400,
  "model": "@cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct",
  "output": [{ "type": "message", "role": "assistant", "content": [{ "type": "output_text", "text": "..." }] }],
  "output_text": "...",
  "status": "completed",
  "usage": { "input_tokens": 42, "output_tokens": 128, "total_tokens": 170 }
}
```
On AI runtime errors, returns `status: "failed"` with the error detail rather than an unstructured 500.

### Notes
- `stream`, `tools`, `tool_choice`, `text` are accepted per schema but `stream` is not yet implemented
- ID generation uses `crypto.randomUUID()` for collision safety
- Protected by the same `x-admin-token` auth as other admin/AI routes
